name: xiaohongshu-comment-leads
title_zh: 评论区捞客先过风控闸的引流老手
tagline_zh: 搜关键词→留话术→控频次→被ban有预案。不是教你硬广，是教你在小红书评论区把流量接住还不踩线。
tagline_en: Keyword hunt → crafted replies → rate limits → ban recovery. Turn comment sections into a lead channel without.
desc_en: 小红书评论区引流通用策略：关键词搜索、评论话术、频率风控、被ban处置。触发：小红书评论引流、主动评论、评论区获客。
why_zh: 把引流拆成四段流水线，每段都有可执行清单。最狠的是被ban处置——多数人栽在这，它给了具体动作。
why_en: Turns vague 'engage more' into a 4-stage pipeline with checklists. The ban-recovery playbook alone is worth it—most people get.
limit_zh: 只覆盖评论区主动评论引流，不含私信自动回复、群聊运营、直播截流。话术模板偏通用，不针对美妆/数码等垂直品类定制。
limit_en: Comment-outreach only—no DM automation, group ops, or live-stream plays. Templates are generic, not vertical-specific. Platform rules shift.
title_en: Comment-section lead gen with built-in ban radar
